name: deaneeth/airbnb-market-intelligence-pipeline
what_it_holds: Reproducible, config-driven pipeline that pulls Inside Airbnb's public detailed-listings/calendar/reviews/neighbourhood files (currently configured for Amsterdam, snapshot 2026-06-15) and turns them into typed Parquet, a DuckDB star schema, SQL summaries, ML benchmarks, and a Streamlit dashboard. Explicitly excludes raw/staged/processed data files from version control (pull-only, no committed data). Adding a new city is a one-line configs/cities.yml change, no code change. 69 commits, active as of July 2026.
why_useful: Could be repurposed as our own DuckDB/Parquet ingestion layer for Inside Airbnb pulls (we already query raw stores via DuckDB per CLAUDE.md), marginal net-new data value.
duplicate_of_holding: overlaps our own Inside Airbnb capture/query tooling

why_all: Could be repurposed as our own DuckDB/Parquet ingestion layer for Inside Airbnb pulls (we already query raw stores via DuckDB per CLAUDE.md), marginal net-new data value.

name: luminati-io/Airbnb-dataset-samples
what_it_holds: airbnb-properties-information.csv with 1,001 sample rows drawn from a larger Bright Data commercial dataset described as covering 'more than 11,000,000' Airbnb-adjacent records; fields include property id/name/url, price, location/coordinates, guest capacity, host info, amenities, availability dates, ratings/reviews. Full dataset obtainable (paid) via Bright Data API on a custom refresh cadence (once/daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly).
why_useful: Not historical, small sample, and points at a paid commercial scraping API rather than free/committed bulk data; flagged only because it demonstrates a live commercial Airbnb-listings API exists (out of scope per CLAUDE.md's 'no scraping airbnb.com beyond sanctioned sources' rule, and this is a vendor sample, not usable directly), so treat as informational only, not actionable.

A commercially-scraped, apparently current, very large-scale Airbnb listings dataset (11M+ full size) exists behind Bright Data's paid API; the free sample is small (1,001 rows, no stated cities/years) but flags that a paid, current, global Airbnb listing feed is available if the team ever wants pricing/availability at a scale beyond Inside Airbnb. Scraping airbnb.com — per our rules this is a human ToS decision, not something to run ourselves.

A committed, free sample of a large third-party Airbnb listing/price/availability dataset (not AirDNA, but a comparable commercial 'sample export' in scope for this theme); available_dates field could feed a lightweight occupancy proxy for whatever cities appear in the 1,001 rows. Small and not point-in-time, so low standalone value, but worth noting as a template for what Bright Data (and similar vendors) will give away.

Only a small free sample is committed; the substantive data sits behind Bright Data's paid product. Marginal value as a one-time cross-check of listing counts/prices in a handful of markets, not a real time series.
